gloss: fighting on alone; a lone struggle

definitions.gloss: fighting on alone; struggling without support
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) for carrying on a hard fight by oneself, with no reinforcements and no help from those around you. Used of work, sport, and campaigns far more often than of actual battle.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}している。
{誰|だれ}も{手伝|てつだ}ってくれず、{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}の{毎日|まいにち}だ。
examples.english: Nobody helps out, so every day is a lone struggle.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{制度|せいど}を{通|とお}すため、{一人|ひとり}の{議員|ぎいん}が{数年間|すうねんかん}{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}を{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: One legislator kept up a lone struggle for several years to get the new system passed.

notes:
From {孤軍|こぐん} (an isolated army) + {奮闘|ふんとう} (to struggle hard). The tone is sympathetic: it praises the effort while pointing out that the person should not have had to make it alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}する: to fight on alone
- {孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}を{続|つづ}ける: to keep up a lone struggle
- {孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}ぶり: the sight of someone struggling alone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪戦苦闘|あくせんくとう}: a desperate struggle — stresses how hard the fight is, not the isolation
- {奮闘|ふんとう}: to struggle hard — the plain word, with no sense of being alone
